welcome.title: Welcome to Baton
welcome.body: This is a private demo workspace with five sample tasks. Nothing here touches your real work. The tour takes about two minutes.

board-columns.title: Work moves from left to right
board-columns.body: Every task sits in a column: To do, In progress, In review or Done.

task-card.title: Each card is one task with one owner
task-card.body: The key, the title and the owner are on the card. Open a card to see the details.

waits-on.title: Tasks can wait on each other
waits-on.body: This task waits on the API endpoint. You can finish it only after its blocker is done.

nav-my-tasks.title: My tasks: everything assigned to you
nav-my-tasks.body: It lists your tasks from every project, in the order to do them. Press Next to open it, or click it.

my-tasks-intro.title: This is My tasks
my-tasks-intro.body: Your personal list. Baton ranks it so you always know what to do next.

my-tasks-next.title: Your next task
my-tasks-next.body: The top card is the task to do now.

nav-board.title: Back to the board
nav-board.body: The Board shows the work of the whole team. Press Next, or click Board, to go back.

move-task.title: Finish “Build the payments API endpoint”
move-task.body: Click the status, then choose Done.

unblocked.title: “Write tests for the payments API” is unblocked
unblocked.body: The lock is gone because its blocker is done. In your team, this is when the owner gets told they can start.

nav-settings.title: Settings: connect your agents
nav-settings.body: Your coding agents can work in Baton too. Press Next to open the setup page.

mcp.title: Let your agents join in
mcp.body: Baton has an MCP server, so agents can read and move tasks like a teammate. Create an API key on this page, then add it to your agent.
